# Northwind Telecom — Billing FAQ

*Synthetic document. Northwind Telecom is a fictional operator invented for testing; every figure
below is made up and describes no real product, tariff or person.*

## When is my bill generated?

Within two days of the close of your billing cycle. The cycle date is fixed at activation and does
not move when a plan changes.

## How can I pay?

From the app or the website by card, net banking or UPI; by standing instruction on a card or bank
account; or in cash at a Northwind Telecom store. Cash payments at a store are receipted immediately
and reflect on the account within one working day.

## What happens if I pay late?

A late fee of ₹100 or 2% of the outstanding amount applies, whichever is higher. Outgoing services
are barred seven days after the due date and incoming services seven days after that. The connection
is closed 60 days after the due date and the number is released.

## How do I set up a standing instruction?

From the app, under Payments, choose Autopay and authorise the mandate. The first automatic debit
happens on the next bill, not the current one. A mandate can be cancelled at any time and takes
effect immediately.

## Why is my first bill higher than the plan rent?

The first bill covers the days between activation and the first cycle close, plus the full rent for
the first complete cycle. It also carries any installation charge that was not waived.

## Can I get an itemised bill?

Yes. An itemised statement of calls, messages and data sessions for the last six cycles can be
downloaded from the app at no charge. Statements older than six cycles are available on request and
take up to five working days.

## Can I dispute a charge?

Yes, within 30 days of the bill date. The disputed amount is held and not treated as overdue while
the dispute is open. Disputes are decided within 15 working days.
